adapter_evidence.product_pages: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/products-services/product/<slug>.html. Gas turbine pages (SGT-800, SGT6-5000F …) carry native HTML 'Performance data for simple cycle / combined cycle' and 'Physical dimensions and weight' tables with one column per rating; power-transformers.html carries a type comparison table (voltage range, power rating, cooling).
adapter_evidence.no_tables: Gas-insulated switchgear (no 8DA/8DQ product page; the GIS family page and LIFE Blue GIS have no table), HVDC, GEAFOL and fluid-immersed distribution transformer pages have no specification table.
adapter_evidence.robots: robots.txt disallows only /xy/ and declares https://www.siemens-energy.com/sitemap.xml (per-country indexes; /global/en.sitemap.xml lists every product page).

known_gaps: High-voltage switchgear (8DA/8DQ GIS) has no product page with a table; P.hv-switchyard.* stays open.
Transformer losses and lifetime (P.transformer.operation) are not on the product pages.
Datasheets on other hosts are outside allowed_hosts; only the product pages' own tables are read.
map-sync is not enabled; product pages are named by reviewed seeds.
